description: Staff picks in Boston, Denver, San Francisco, Nashville or New York, each with a one-line reason. Use this for “what should I see?”, “what’s good”, “anything worth going to?”, “featured”, “date night”, “romantic”, or any public curated list. Always cite `url` (app deep link /e/?id=). Do not rewrite to /event/. Omit collection to list every public collection (id + title + counts) plus the default featured+popular pages. Intent → collection: date night / romantic / nice night out → date_night (do NOT use sort=popular alone); what’s good / featured → featured; big names / popular → popular; local / underrated → local_scene (or local_bands / under_the_radar); comedy night → comedy (for “comedy this week?” prefer search_shows event_type=comedy); jazz → jazz (or search genre=jazz); kids / family → tots_picks; older crowd / boomer → senior; foobos / Scott / Tot staff → foobos / scotts_picks / tots_picks; free curated → free_tonight (or shows_free); punk curated → punk (or search genre=punk); weeknight gems → weeknight_gems; St. Patrick’s → st_patricks. Not personalized For You — there is no account on this API. Each pick includes editorial `why` when the curated row has one so you can cite the reason. Each collection is paginated (default 20, max 50) and includes its own total.

city.description: boston (default: Boston, Cambridge, Somerville and the rest of Greater Boston, Massachusetts), denver (Denver, Boulder and the Colorado Front Range), sanfrancisco (San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley and the rest of the Bay Area), nashville (Nashville, Franklin, Murfreesboro and the rest of Middle Tennessee) or newyork (the five boroughs of New York City and the big rooms just outside them). Set denver for anything in Colorado, sanfrancisco for anything in the Bay Area, nashville for anything in Middle Tennessee and newyork for anything in New York City.

collection.description: One public curated key. Omit for available catalog + featured/popular.

limit.description: Page size. Default 20, max 50. Do not request the full list — tonight is ~174 shows / ~36k tokens.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use with the returned total to page.

via.description: Inbound UTM source written onto every Foobos deep link. Default muse.
